rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose way to say that something is beneficial or helpful.

example.english: Eating more vegetables is advantageous for your health.
example.traditional: 食多啲菜對身體有好處。
example.jyutping: sik6 do1 di1 coi3 deoi3 san1 tai2 jau5 hou2 cyu3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that someone personally gains an advantage or benefit.

example.english: Buying the bundle now is most advantageous.
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 maai5 tou3 zong1 zeoi3 jau5 zoek6 sou3

rows.note: Use this especially for a favorable condition, position, or outcome, and in more formal or written contexts.

example.english: This location is advantageous for developing new business.
example.traditional: 呢個地點對發展新業務有利。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 dei6 dim2 deoi3 faat3 zin2 san1 jip6 mou6 jau5 lei6
